name: sentry_list_issues
description: List Sentry issues filtered by query, sort, environment, and project. Defaults to unresolved issues sorted by date.

name: sentry_get_issue
description: Get full details for a specific Sentry issue by its ID.

name: sentry_update_issue
description: Update a Sentry issue's status, assignee, or seen state.

name: sentry_resolve_issue
description: Mark a Sentry issue as resolved.

name: sentry_ignore_issue
description: Ignore a Sentry issue so it stops appearing in the default view.

name: sentry_delete_issue
description: Permanently delete a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_list_issue_events
description: List events (individual occurrences) for a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_get_latest_event
description: Get the most recent event for a Sentry issue, including full stack trace.

name: sentry_bulk_update_issues
description: Update multiple Sentry issues at once — e.g. resolve or ignore a batch of issues.

name: sentry_assign_issue
description: Assign a Sentry issue to a specific user or team.

name: sentry_list_issue_tags
description: List all tags attached to a Sentry issue (browser, environment, user, etc.).

name: sentry_get_issue_tag_values
description: Get all distinct values for a specific tag on a Sentry issue — e.g. all affected user emails.

tag_key.description: Tag key e.g. user, browser, environment

name: sentry_get_issue_hashes
description: Get the event hashes used for deduplication of a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_merge_issues
description: Merge multiple Sentry issues into a single parent issue.

name: sentry_list_project_events
description: List raw events for a Sentry project with optional query filtering.

name: sentry_get_event
description: Get a specific event by its ID in a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_projects
description: List all Sentry projects in the organization.

name: sentry_get_project
description: Get details for a specific Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_project
description: Create a new Sentry project under a team.

name: sentry_update_project
description: Update a Sentry project's name, platform, or settings.

name: sentry_delete_project
description: Delete a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_project_stats
description: Get event volume statistics for a Sentry project over a time range.

name: sentry_list_project_keys
description: List DSN client keys for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_project_key
description: Create a new DSN client key for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_delete_project_key
description: Delete a DSN client key from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_teams
description: List all teams in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_team
description: Get details for a specific Sentry team.

name: sentry_create_team
description: Create a new team in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_update_team
description: Update a Sentry team's name.

name: sentry_delete_team
description: Delete a Sentry team.

name: sentry_list_team_members
description: List members of a Sentry team.

name: sentry_list_members
description: List all members of the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_member
description: Get details for a specific organization member.

name: sentry_list_releases
description: List releases for the organization or a specific project.

name: sentry_get_release
description: Get details for a specific release version.

name: sentry_create_release
description: Create a new release in Sentry to associate errors with a specific version.

version.description: Release version e.g. '1.2.0' or a git SHA

name: sentry_finalize_release
description: Mark a release as finalized/deployed in Sentry.

name: sentry_delete_release
description: Delete a release from Sentry.

name: sentry_list_release_commits
description: List commits associated with a Sentry release.

name: sentry_list_release_deploys
description: List deployments for a Sentry release.

name: sentry_create_release_deploy
description: Record a deployment event for a Sentry release in a specific environment.

name: sentry_list_alert_rules
description: List metric alert rules for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_alert_rule
description: Get details for a specific Sentry metric alert rule.

name: sentry_delete_alert_rule
description: Delete a metric alert rule from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_issue_alert_rules
description: List issue-based alert rules (notifications) for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_monitors
description: List all cron job monitors in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_monitor
description: Get details for a specific cron monitor.

name: sentry_create_monitor
description: Create a new cron job monitor to track scheduled job health.

name: sentry_update_monitor
description: Update a cron monitor's schedule or mute state.

name: sentry_delete_monitor
description: Delete a cron monitor.

name: sentry_list_monitor_checkins
description: List recent check-ins for a cron monitor to see health history.

name: sentry_get_org_stats
description: Get organization-wide error/transaction volume stats grouped by outcome.

name: sentry_list_dashboards
description: List all dashboards in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_dashboard
description: Get a specific Sentry dashboard and its widgets.

name: sentry_list_debug_files
description: List debug info files (dSYMs, PDB files, source maps) for a project.

name: sentry_list_source_map_archives
description: List source map artifact bundles uploaded to a Sentry project.

name: sentry_triage_errors
description: SUPER TOOL: Get top unresolved errors sorted by user impact — issue ID, title, error count, users affected, and last seen — ready for triage.

name: sentry_production_health
description: SUPER TOOL: Production health check — project count, top 5 recent unresolved issues, and error volume stats in one call.

name: sentry_deploy_release
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a release in Sentry and immediately mark it as deployed to an environment — the standard CI/CD workflow in one call.
